# Browse files and folders
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Find files and folders in a workspace and control which folders are open in the Files sidebar section.

## Browse the folder tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/files.ts -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

1. Select a workspace that is a Git repository.
2. Open the **Files** sidebar section.
3. Click a folder row to fold or unfold that folder.
4. Click a file row to select it and open it in the large Git window.

The tree shows files tracked by Git and new files. When the option to show ignored files is on, ignored folders also appear, but they cannot be unfolded.

## Refresh or fold the tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

Select **Refresh** to read the tree again, or select **Collapse all folders** to fold every folder. Heidrun also reads the tree again when the repository or its changed-file count changes.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

### The Files sidebar section says the workspace is not a Git repository
**Cause**: The selected workspace is not a Git repository.
**Solution**:
1. Select a workspace that is a Git repository.
2. Open the **Files** sidebar section.
**Check**: The folder tree appears.

# Change the Files sidebar section appearance
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Adjust the indentation, row height, and indent guides in the Files sidebar section.

## Choose the appearance
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

1. Select **More options** in the Files sidebar section.
2. Under **Indentation**, choose **Small**, **Medium**, or **Large**.
3. Under **Row height**, choose **Compact** or **Comfortable**.
4. Under **Indent guides**, choose **Show** or **Hide**.

Heidrun saves these choices.

# Create a file or folder
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Create an empty file or folder in the repository of the selected workspace.

## Choose where to create the item
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

Select a folder to create the item there, or select a file to create the item in that file's folder. With no row selected, the item goes in the repository root.

## Create the file or folder
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

1. Select **New file** or **New folder** in the Files sidebar section.
2. Enter a name without `/` and press **Enter**.

The new row is selected. A new file also opens in the large Git window. Press **Escape** or click outside the name box to cancel name entry.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

### The name box stays open after Enter
**Cause**: The name contains `/` or already exists in the selected folder.
**Solution**:
1. Remove `/` from the name or choose a name that is not already in the folder.
2. Press **Enter**.
**Check**: The new row appears in the folder tree and is selected.

# Files sidebar section
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: reference -->

Look up what the Files sidebar section shows and what its controls do.

## Folder tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/files.ts -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

The tree shows files tracked by Git and new files. Folders appear before files, and each group is listed alphabetically. A changed file has a status letter at the right of its row, and a folder containing changes has a dot.
When the option to show ignored files is on, ignored folders also appear; they cannot be unfolded. The tree can include empty folders created during the current run of Heidrun. If the list is too long, Heidrun shows “The list is too long: only the first files are shown.”

## Header buttons
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

| Name | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **New file** | Starts creating an empty file in the selected folder, the folder of the selected file, or the repository root. |
| **New folder** | Starts creating an empty folder in the selected folder, the folder of the selected file, or the repository root. |
| **Refresh** | Reads the folder tree again. |
| **Collapse all folders** | Folds every folder. |
| **More options** | Opens the choices for indentation, row height, and indent guides. |

## More options
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

| Name | Choices |
| --- | --- |
| **Indentation** | **Small**, **Medium**, or **Large** |
| **Row height** | **Compact** or **Comfortable** |
| **Indent guides** | **Show** or **Hide** |

Heidrun saves these choices.

## Selecting and folding rows
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/files.ts -->

Clicking a file or folder selects its row; only one row is selected for the current workspace. Click empty space in the Files sidebar section to clear the selection for that workspace. Each workspace remembers its selected row, and Heidrun unfolds the folders above that row when you return to the workspace.

The selection stays when you show another sidebar section or close the large Git window. Folder folds stay when you show another sidebar section.

## Opening files
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/GitModal.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/gitModal.json -->

Clicking a file opens it in the large Git window. An unchanged file appears as a whole file, with **Diff** and **Side by side** disabled.

## File context menu
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

Right-click a file row to open its context menu. **Copy absolute path** copies the file's absolute path, and **Copy relative path** copies its path relative to the workspace folder; Heidrun shows the copied path in a message. Folder rows have no context menu.
